summary: Configured and verified nightly backups from node2 to node1. Dated archives are stored in /var/backups/inventory, files older than seven days are removed, and the configuration survived sequential restarts of both nodes.
actions_performed: Created the initially absent /srv/inventory/data directory on node2 without adding business data.
Generated a dedicated Ed25519 key and restricted it to the fixed inventory export command from node1.
Installed an atomic backup script and persistent systemd timer scheduled nightly at 02:15 with up to 15 minutes randomized delay.
Verified archive integrity and exercised retention by confirming an eight-day-old test archive was removed.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually, confirming changed boot identities and full recovery after each.
Confirmed RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8 remained unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Nightly dated backup from node2 to node1
evidence.summary: Timer is enabled and active; successful runs produced /var/backups/inventory/inventory-2026-10-03.tar.gz with valid gzip/tar contents, including after both restarts.

evidence.requirement: Retain only the last seven days
evidence.summary: An eight-day-old test archive was removed, and the final script shows the constrained -mtime +6 cleanup rule.
A dedicated key was generated, restricted by source address and forced export command, and node2 host keys were pinned.

evidence.requirement: Preserve installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8 before and after restart.
Healthy baseline boot ID 9feeb0bb-6fe6-40fb-9831-d869ed07631c, acknowledged safe reboot, new boot ID 14080096-332b-4f62-b11c-a64294eda0d7, and recovered timer plus successful backup.

Healthy baseline boot ID bef0e5ec-ce32-423b-826a-8a5a90584d3a, acknowledged safe reboot, new boot ID d72b0110-44ae-4468-ab66-b88ca0fae914, recovered SSH/source state, and successful cross-node backup afterward.
